breakdown.description: A horizontal traction on the vertical edge x = 0 is reinterpreted as tangential shear, even though it is normal to that edge
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies the traction on x = 0 as t = (4000, 0) Pa — a horizontal vector — without reinterpreting it as a shear/tangential traction. This correctly treats it as a normal traction on the vertical edge, matching the ground truth and avoiding the erroneous shear reinterpretation present in the incomplete prompt.
